links.outcome: Clinical applicability of LLM responses to liver cancer questions, professional vs common-sense
links.effect: Kimi and GPT-4 had the highest fully applicable responses (68% and 62%); none consistently guideline-concordant; professional-level questions scored significantly lower than common-sense ones.
links.quote: However, none of the LLMs consistently provided guideline-concordant answers to all questions.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, comprehensibility, and clinical applicability of 5 LLMs on 90 standardized liver cancer questions with expert ratings; does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
